'''September 2001 Austin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Junior's, Austin, Texas on 8 September 2001. It is known from Zane Thorp's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2958">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-12-juniors-in-austin-9-8-01d2958/ juniors-in-austin-9-8-01], DeckTech (Zane "Godzanet" Thorp, 12 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-12-juniors-in-austin-9-8-01d2958/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Junior's, Austin, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
